# Edraw Software

> > Edraw Software is a comprehensive diagramming and design platform offering 20,000+ templates with cross-platform support (Windows, Mac, Linux) and Visio compatibility.

Edraw Software provides an all-in-one visual design solution for professionals across engineering, business, and creative industries. The platform emphasizes collaboration features, free templates, and multiple export formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, SVG) to support diverse workflow needs.

## Key Topics

- EdrawMax
- Diagram software
- Visio alternative
- Cross-platform
- Free templates
- Drag-and-drop editor
- Data visualization
- Collaboration features
- Export formats
- Project management
- UML diagrams
- Network diagrams
- Wireframing
- Template library
- Multi-platform support
